lead: Low-level OS-thread primitives: `sys.Thread.spawn(...)`, `ThreadOptions`, `ThreadLocal<T>`, `OsMutex`, `OsRwLock`, `OsCondvar`, `OsBarrier`, `OsOnce`, process/dylib/pipe handles, CPU/thread helpers, and signal hooks. `sys.Thread.spawn` is compiler-defined; it returns the prelude `Thread<T>` handle with `join`, `detach`, and `done`. Coroutine-friendly delays belong to `time.sleep(ms)`.
